title: Take a photo with the camera

source.changes: Instruction is the source's goal, word for word ("Take a photo."; the source's name says selfie, its goal and check don't). The source counted MediaStore images added since setup, or more image files in /sdcard/Pictures; ours counts image files in /sdcard/DCIM and /sdcard/Pictures newer than a marker setup writes, which covers the vendor camera apps' folders, and leaves out Screenshots folders and unfinished (.pending) files so a screenshot can't pass. HEIC is counted as well as the source's JPEG, PNG and DNG. Teardown deletes the run's new images. The oracle saves a screen capture into DCIM/Camera: it proves the check reads a new camera-folder image, not that a camera app works.

setup.why: Write the start marker once (a retried setup keeps the first), then wait a second so a photo taken right after is newer.

checks.why: At least one finished image file (JPEG, HEIC, PNG or DNG) under /sdcard/DCIM or /sdcard/Pictures, outside Screenshots folders, is newer than the marker setup wrote. Nothing is newer after setup, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Delete the images made since setup (the same files the check counts), drop the marker and go home.

argv: d=/data/local/tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}; [ -e $d/t0 ] && find /sdcard/DCIM /sdcard/Pictures -type f -newer $d/t0 ! -path '*/Screenshots/*' \( -iname '*.jpg' -o -iname '*.jpeg' -o -iname '*.heic' -o -iname '*.png' -o -iname '*.dng' \) -exec rm -f {} + 2>/dev/null; rm -rf $d; input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME; true

oracle.why: Save a new image into the camera folder, the state a photo leaves.
